chapters.label: Agriculture Connecting Better Living
narration: From a single seed to a family’s dining table; from a field to the lives of thousands of households. Every effort in agriculture deserves thoughtful attention.
Huahai AgriTech: bringing technology closer to agriculture, and making quality more visible.

Shenzhen Huahai AgriTech Group Co., Ltd., founded in 2017. As a Shenzhen-based enterprise supporting Xinjiang development, Huahai anchors itself in agriculture and drives progress with AI, connecting technology R&D, production services, trade circulation, and industrial collaboration.
Spanning crop cultivation, livestock and aquaculture, and extending into processing, food R&D, and data services, Huahai AgriTech is exploring industrial connectivity from field to table.

Agriculture involves more than just production. Efforts in the field need to be understood by the market; market needs deserve to be heard by origins. Connecting these two ends is where Huahai begins its thinking on industrial development.

For producers, we focus on management and supply; for merchants, on product representation and logistics collaboration; for households, on information, choice, and service. Connecting these needs through technology is Huahai AgriTech’s ongoing development direction.

chapters.label: Advancing agriculture with technology, enabling with AI, prioritizing food safety
narration: Advancing agriculture with technology, enabling with AI, prioritizing food safety. This is Huahai AgriTech’s commitment

The value of technology lies in the field, in the water, and in every authentic production and service interaction. Observing environmental changes, documenting farming activities, valuing product origin and quality—each step reflects greater care.

Advancing agriculture with technology means bringing tools directly to where they are truly needed — enabling frontline personnel to understand production processes more easily, and allowing daily accumulated experience to create value alongside data

AI empowerment means making complex information easier to understand. Facing diverse crops, varied farming environments, and differing consumer demands, technology should support people in making better-informed decisions.

‘Food safety first’ means placing attention to quality at every step of production, processing, and distribution—from source documentation to batch information, from product descriptions to after-sales service—treating each product with care, and each family with care.

chapters.label: Let data serve the industry
narration: On the farm or in aquaculture settings, sensors and intelligent gateways help observe changes in fields and water bodies; on the data platform, artificial intelligence helps organize information to support management decisions and selection.
Let data and professional expertise work in tandem — making agricultural technology a helper for cultivation, livestock farming, and industry services

Connecting on-site operations with the platform forms the foundation of this approach. Organizing fragmented information—from fields and ponds to business processes—enables clearer grounding for industrial collaboration.

Beyond agriculture and food, Huahai AgriTech also explores synthetic biology, agricultural product processing, and trusted information services—balancing attention to digital technologies with attention to raw materials, products, and the industry itself.

We hope that as technology enters agriculture, what remains is not a string of obscure terms—but clearer processes, more evidence-based judgments, and smoother communication between people and the industry.

chapters.label: Aimaimai: Connecting quality products with everyday needs
narration: Starting from the origin, agriculture must also enter daily life. Aimaimai is Huahai AgriTech’s key product vehicle connecting agricultural products, merchants, and consumers.

The Buyer App and WeChat Mini Program help consumers learn about products and express purchasing needs—linking shopping and services. The Seller and Management Backends coordinate merchants and platforms around products, orders, and fulfillment.
Search for products, view supporting information, or describe what you’d like to buy using natural language. Clearer information connects you with more suitable options.

Facing three daily meals, consumers often ask: What is this product? What are its specifications? Where does it come from? Does it meet my selection criteria? Product documentation, batch information, and service access points serve as the starting point for addressing these questions.

Facing daily operations, merchants need to clearly articulate their products, organize specifications and inventory effectively, and align orders with fulfillment. Aimaimai provides foundational agricultural e-commerce products and business infrastructure around these steps.

For the platform, merchant and product review, order operations, and service coordination jointly support the transaction process. Buyers, merchants, and the platform each fulfill distinct roles while collaborating along the same service chain.

AI can assist in interpreting search and purchasing requests—connecting a natural-language statement to product queries and corresponding services. This brings technology into everyday use while making operations more aligned with human expression habits.

chapters.label: From Production to Consumption: Enabling Connection Through Collaboration
narration: From production records to grading, quality control, and packaging; from commodity transactions to delivery fulfillment and consumer feedback. Huahai is exploring a collaborative model across the full AI-powered production-to-sales chain.

Let real demand inform supply organization; let production and product information help express quality; let consumer feedback support the next cycle of product selection, inventory preparation, and industry improvement

Imagine a journey for an aquaculture product: beginning with farming records from the pond, proceeding through grading and testing to generate batch and packaging documentation, then moving via merchant and transaction services to the family dining table.

Consumers prioritize specifications, taste, and service; merchants prioritize order fulfillment; origin sites prioritize subsequent supply arrangements. Structuring these pieces of information enables reference for the next round of product portfolio and supply planning.

This is the industry collaboration Huahai AgriTech aims to build progressively: connecting supply to authentic demand; using production and product documentation to express quality; and supporting continuous improvement through ongoing feedback. AI assists in understanding information, organizing needs, and generating suggestions.

chapters.label: Focusing on Origins, Food, and Family Life
narration: Huahai’s AI-driven agriculture/food/wellbeing ecosystem is grounded in agriculture and food, focusing on origin production, food quality, nutritional information, and daily consumption services.

From green inputs and farm management, to food R&D and processing, and finally to household dining tables. Huahai seeks to collaborate with agricultural bases, food enterprises, research institutions, and industry partners to explore connections between technology and daily life.

For households, the Agriculture-Food-Wellbeing Ecosystem begins with understanding food—knowing ingredients and origins, interpreting product labels and nutritional data, and gradually forming personalized points of attention in everyday choices.

For the industry, this is a pathway connecting agricultural production, food R&D, processing, and consumer services—ensuring raw material value is rigorously studied, product information is clearly communicated, and daily life needs are consistently addressed.

This ecosystem pathway requires long-term development and joint participation by industry partners. Huahai AgriTech aims to connect source production, product R&D, and household consumption through technology and industry collaboration—step by step—to bring agriculture closer to a better life.
Advancing agriculture with technology, enabling with AI, prioritizing food safety. Huahai AgriTech — connecting agriculture to a better life, together with you
